posts.title: Kazakhstan- Notes from a Country I Knew Nothing About
posts.description: Seven days in Almaty I. The Choosing We did not choose Kazakhstan. Kazakhstan was what remained after everything else had been eliminated, which is a different thing entirely, and I say this without embarrassment, because most of the best places I have been to arrived in my life the same way. posts.title: Sri Lanka trip -The Safest Place to Be Afraid
posts.description: Six days in the water, and one long drive inland I Colombo is not far. The map says so plainly — a short hop across a narrow stretch of sea, nearer to me than half of my own country.
